messages:
Maya (Product): Kicking off acceptance gates for BYOK keystore onboarding. Need to align SOC2 evidence, retention SLAs, and SME signoffs. Can we draft a minimal checklist and a hard timebox?
Arun (Eng): +1. Do we have an existing template for evidence we can reuse or should we make a slim one for MVP customers?
Maya (Product): Prefer slim. Core must-haves: key custody proof, handshake audit entries, retention TTL options, and exportable evidence bundle.
Tess (Security): Also add key rotation metadata and access policy snapshots. SOC2 will want traceability for changes.
Sam (Solutions): Customers keep asking about import/export flow during migration — need clear steps in docs and a rollback playbook.
Priya (Legal): For enterprise contracts we need retention ranges and a clause for legal-hold exports. Can we capture that as a checkbox?
Maya (Product): Yes. Proposed acceptance gates (MVP): 1) Keystore handshake success log + replayable audit, 2) Export format + integrity hash, 3) Retention TTL control per-tenant, 4) Legal-hold snapshot.
Arun (Eng): Implementation notes: handshake logs are already emitted by handshake-service, but we need an indexed, immutable copy for evidence. I can add a sidecar writer to object-storage.
Tess (Security): Immutable copy must be tamper-evident (hash chain). Also need an audit access audit trail so we know who fetched snapshots.
Sam (Solutions): For customers, we should provide a lightweight script to verify hash chain and an example export command. Eg: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keystores/{id}/export`
Maya (Product): Timebox: aim for canary by end of sprint (2 weeks). If not feasible, prioritize the export + immutable storage first.
Arun (Eng): 2 weeks is tight. I can deliver immutable logs + export endpoint in that window; retention per-tenant UI will be follow-up.
Priya (Legal): For contracts, we need default retention options (90/365/730 days) and an override path for custom SLAs. Also request a Data Processing Addendum update.
Tess (Security): We should define what counts as "evidence" in the acceptance doc. Minimal: handshake log, key metadata, export integrity hash, access log covering that export.
Maya (Product): Good. Action items: Arun -> PR for sidecar writer + export endpoint (due EOD Fri), Sam -> sample verification script + docs snippet, Tess -> evidence definition doc, Priya -> retention clause language. I'll compile into a one-pager checklist.
Arun (Eng): FYI: will add feature flag `byok_evidence_mvp` to allow safe rollout.
DeployBot: deploy-prod: canary `byok-evidence-v1` scheduled to staging at 03:00 UTC.
Sam (Solutions): Quick question — for on-prem/private deployments, customers may want offline export. Add note to docs: `--offline-pack` mode.
Maya (Product): Noted. We'll include an offline export variant in the playbook.
Tess (Security): One more ask: include a replay test so we can validate that evidence bundle reconstructs the handshake state. Test vectors please.
Arun (Eng): I'll include a small test harness in the PR.
Maya (Product): OK team — I'll share the checklist draft in #product by tomorrow morning and tag everyone for signoff. Thanks :thumbsup:
Priya (Legal): Will review retention wording after draft.
Sam (Solutions): Happy to run a customer dry-run next week if needed.
Maya (Product): Great. Closing thread for now, reopening if blockers appear.
